highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.159.0 release brings Skia m159 improvements and requires .NET 9 or later for WebAssembly.
highlights_body: The engine update brings WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering correctness fixes. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

breaking.title: Move WebAssembly consumers to .NET 9 or later
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets; unsupported WASM frameworks are rejected before building. Retarget WebAssembly apps to .NET 9 or later and use runtime-matched native archives: .NET 9/10 use Emscripten 3.1.56, while .NET 11+ use 6.0.2. Newer archives are not interchangeable with older .NET toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Updates the native engine with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and image and rendering correctness fixes. C API exports and public managed signatures remain unchanged.

The shared HashCode polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now loads the cryptography library.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash-code seed with OS-backed randomness and added analyzer enforcement for shipped code.
